scientific_integrity: An explicit 21-vertex Laplacian, verified 432-element affine action, eleven conjugacy classes, full modular-rank census, two-sink integer Smith forms, and the perfect graph-monodromy pairing support the exact finite classification.
scientific_limitations: The exact table concerns the Hesse boundary graph and its affine automorphism action; it does not prove realization of all conjugacy classes over every finite field or semistable smoothing existence. The nonequivariant critical group is background and not claimed novel.
title: Eleven integral Frobenius-fixed graph Jacobians of the Hesse 21-curve boundary
